content:
Chapter 9 Deterrence

He called Wang Daniu and asked him to order a team of people, number 50, and go with him to find a place to set up a refugee camp in front of the government office.

The reason why he had to order his troops was to prevent those exiled campers from losing their heads and daring to attack him, so as to protect his own safety by the way.

It can also be used to suppress the refugee camps, so that they obediently listen to their own words and accept their own arrangements. After all, these starving refugees, who knows they have no control? What's the matter?

Going all the way to the front of the mansion, walking a mile forward, there is an open and flat plain, right in front of the mansion, from the entrance of the mansion, you can see the situation there clearly at a glance.

When he arrived at the location, Zhong Yu carefully checked the surrounding terrain. The grass here is a little lower and it is not easy to hide. When the refugees escape from the camp, they are not afraid that no one will see it!

And there are two relatively high hillsides on both sides. If you install a watchtower on the hillside, you can monitor the entire camp at a glance, and you can also check the surrounding conditions for early warning.

This is a very strategic place, so here it is! After choosing this place, he said to the system, "System, lay out refugee camps."

Another white ray of light flashed, and in the blur, the illusory shape of a building was being formed, and the overall structure was being built rapidly. Slowly, a somewhat crude refugee camp was forming and appeared in front of Zhong Yu.

Ask Wang Daniu to take the fifty people and divide them into five teams, leave ten people to protect themselves, and divide the remaining forty people into four directions to surround the refugee camp to prevent them from escaping in the chaos. Suppress chaos.

As the light in front of him dissipated, the refugee camp gradually heard some people's voices from the current Zhong Yu's eyes, slowly getting louder and louder, and it seemed that someone was inside, arguing about something.

Slowly, the voice is getting closer and closer, has it come to the door of the refugee camp? Several sturdy refugees came out. The man at the head looked quite sturdy, with a fierce meaning, depicted in his eyes, and behind the man, there were six men.

Among them, the man on his left is rather thin and looks like a monkey, with thief eyebrows and rat eyes.

On the right side, was a very sturdy man. He looked a little silly, and his body exuded a sturdy smell. It seemed that he should be a thug, or the one who took the lead.

After that, the four people were nothing special, that is to say, the ordinary peasant man had nothing more than a ferocious meaning, thinking that he was just a group of minions, and there was nothing to worry about.

The man in the lead came out with a fierce face, saw Zhong Yu in front of the camp, and was stunned for a moment, then you wanted to follow the soldiers behind Zhong Yu.

Ten people lined up neatly in a row, looking at themselves fiercely, with bursts of murderous aura from their bodies, at a glance, they knew that they were elites who had killed people, and they had killed a lot of people.

He looked at him vigilantly, a bit of fear flashed in his eyes, and then his eyes swept to the left and right, and found that there were forty people around, divided into four teams, surrounding the place.

I couldn't help but cringe in my heart, who are these people? How did you surround the camp? Could it be that he came to this strange place because of them?

This is what I thought in my heart, but there was no timid expression on my face, but rather said viciously: "Who are you? Why do you want to surround us, you must know that although you have a lot of people, we are not easy to mess with, know each other, Get out of the way quickly, I think back then, Uncle, I also claimed to be the one who killed a hundred people."

After he finished speaking, his eyes were fixed on Zhong Yu. Obviously, he also knew that the one who could really make the decision here was Zhong Yu, who was carefully guarded by the people around him in the center.

Hearing what he said, in a somewhat lacking tone, Zhong Yu wiped a sneer on the corner of his mouth, and couldn't help but say deeply: "I'll give you a choice, put down your weapons, tie your hands on your back, then kneel down and surrender, and you can have One way to live, or they all die!"

After speaking, Zhong Yu waved his hands. In order to cooperate with Zhong Yu, the ten men who guarded Zhong Yu also raised their swords. It seemed that if they disagreed, they were about to rush up and cut them to pieces. .

Hearing Zhong Yu's cold and ruthless words and the actions of the soldiers around him, the corner of the leader's eyes trembled slightly, his brows furrowed tightly, and he seemed to be thinking, what should he do next?

After about ten breaths, the leader took the lead with his hands and back on his back, knelt down, kowtowed with his head on the ground, and said loudly: "The villain had eyes and did not recognize Mount Tai before, and offended the adults, the villain is willing to surrender, please forgive me. , Forgive the villain's previous sin of disrespect!"

After he finished speaking, his forehead was slapped heavily on the ground for a few more times, and the blood flowed out. After he saw his leader act like this, he was stunned for a while, and quickly followed him. , begging for mercy aloud.

Immediately, the pleadings in front of him resounded all around, seeing the performance of these people in front of him, Zhong Yu nodded with satisfaction, and said slowly: "Get up, for the sake of your sincerity, my lord has something to offer. A lot, don't care about your offense!"

After speaking, Zhong Yu motioned to the soldiers on the left and right to go forward and control them, escort them to the left and right, and wait for the hair to fall.

These people did not dare to resist, they stood up slowly, bent over, followed the soldiers to the side obediently, and let their hands be tied by them.

Slowly, the people in the refugee camp came out slowly, and when they saw the soldiers around them, they did not dare to move, and concentrated on the plain in front of the camp.

Zhong Yu motioned to the soldiers around him to divide half of them and enter the refugee camp to search, and find out all those who were trying to hide.

If someone dared to separate on the way, they would be beaten immediately. After about a stick of incense, all the people in the refugee camp were driven out and gathered in front of the camp.

All the displaced people who were driven out stood in the middle of the open space with fearful expressions on their faces. They, who had always been submissive, faced a group of hungry soldiers, and their fears about the future kept eroding their hearts.

I don't know why this group of soldiers dared them to come here, everyone's heart is full of fear, lingering.

Some of the children have already started to cry, hugging their parents' bodies with both hands, and hugging them tightly with their parents. It seems that this can give those children a little comfort, and they also have a little sustenance in their hearts?

Zhong Yu frowned and looked at the chaotic situation in front of him. He, who always liked neatness and rigor, was a little unhappy about this situation and shouted loudly: "Quiet, you are arguing, don't blame me for being ruthless and change everything. For slaves, never borrow."

When those refugees heard Zhong Yu's cold and ruthless words, their faces were full of fear, but they still suppressed the fear in their hearts and covered their children's mouths, so that they would not dare to make a sound.

Those children also seemed to be frightened by Zhong Yu's ruthless face and terrifying voice, as if they had encountered the devil. , there is no sound at all, only the slight breathing sound is still audible in the field, clearly audible.
